children: shares fell about 6% despite an improved outlook as investors weighed stronger demand against supply bottlenecks and future margin pressure.
The company's latest quarterly update pointed to rising AI infrastructure orders and higher expectations for the coming year, according to a Thursday company release.
HPE said operating margin reached 16.2%, while GAAP earnings were $1.06 a share. Networking revenue totaled $2.9 billion, with orders tied to AI networking reaching $700 million during the quarter.

Cloud and AI revenue came to $9 billion, including nearly $1.6 billion from AI systems. Management also said customer orders continued to run ahead of recognized revenue, reflecting constraints involving memory components and wafer capacity.

The company raised its fiscal 2026 earnings outlook to $3.75 to $3.85 a share and lifted its free cash flow goal to at least $3.75 billion. For fiscal 2027, HPE now expects revenue growth of 13% to 17% and free cash flow of at least $5 billion. It also highlighted an expanded Oracle collaboration targeting large-scale AI infrastructure.
The higher outlook supports HPE's growth case, but supply limits and expected margin normalization may keep investors cautious.

title: Why HPE Stock Is Tanking Today
